title: Derived coherence of the ordinary component square
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Λ and any OrdinarySystem s Λ [def-zl-component-derived-square-data], its normalized ordinary identity and composition equations localize to the two equations System.identity and System.composition for Square.theta, SliceIdentity.derived and SliceComposition.derived with the fixed schemeIdentity and schemeComposition comparisons. This assertion requires no derived tensor structures and constructs no ordinary inverse image.

proof.text: Apply the source-library derived natural-isomorphism composition and whiskering identities, the two unit laws and the associativity law. For identity, derive the equality e followed by i equals j; cancel the canonical composition comparison and use the derived unit laws. For composition, derive the equality between the ordinary three-factor and two-factor composites, then move the derived composition maps across its factors using whiskering naturality and associativity. The resulting formulas specialize to s.identity and s.composition.

lean.statement:
theorem component_derived_square_coherence
    (Λ : Profinite.CondensedRing.{u}) [IsCommMonObj Λ.X] (s : OrdinarySystem Λ) :
    (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
      (K : CondensedRing.Evaluation.D
        ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace X))
        (CondensedRing.profiniteCoefficient Λ.X (affineComponentSpace X))),
    ((s.square (𝟙 X)).theta Λ).hom.app K ≫
        ((s.corner X).derived Λ X).map (((s.sliceIdentity X).derived Λ X).hom.app K) =
      (schemeIdentity Λ X).hom.app (((s.corner X).derived Λ X).obj K)) ∧
    (∀ (X Y Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Z]
      (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
      (K : CondensedRing.Evaluation.D
        ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace X))
        (CondensedRing.profiniteCoefficient Λ.X (affineComponentSpace X))),
    (schemeComposition Λ f g).hom.app (((s.corner X).derived Λ X).obj K) ≫
        (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ.X g).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (((s.square f).theta Λ).hom.app K) ≫
        ((s.square g).theta Λ).hom.app (((s.slice f).derived Λ).obj K) =
      ((s.square (g ≫ f)).theta Λ).hom.app K ≫
        ((s.corner Z).derived Λ Z).map (((s.sliceComposition f g).derived Λ).hom.app K))
